title: fahrenheit_to_celsius returns wrong values
body: `fahrenheit_to_celsius` in `units/temperature.py` gives nonsense: 212 °F comes back as about 194 instead of 100 °C, and 32 °F is not 0 °C. Converting a Celsius value to Fahrenheit and back should give the original value. `celsius_to_fahrenheit` is correct and must not change.
